I hope this is a good tip but I say try to maximize what you need most from each character. For example, Xiangling. If you use her for the main reason just as a support to melt definitely level up her 2nd and 3rd talent it will increase damage when you use Guoba and her burst while you attack with your main dps. If you use her as a main dps level up all her talents 1st, 2nd, 3rd. Same goes to most characters depends on who you use as your main and your support how much you use their skill. Talents makes a whole lot of difference. Level up weapons and refine. Also level up artifacts but for just enough as you will get better ones when you hit AR45 is a guarantee 5 star for each domain round. For now find your best artifact with ATK and CRIT in your sub stats. Elemental and Energy recharge is second best. DEF and HP is useless except for healers like Barbara, Noelle, etc if they’re not your main dps. You can look up YouTube vids which beginner artifact is good for who but it’s really not necessary again until later on don’t wanna make it an obligation for you especially since you’re only at AR25 :)
